about: HIDDEN (held-out) cases for agents C and D, ShopNova only (the bench has no Atlas C cases). Do NOT run, read for tuning, or use to choose prompts, models or training data (CLAUDE.md rule 2). Only the final check runs this file, once (python -m scripts.eval_agents --file tests/data/agents_heldout_cd.json --model callverse-m2-v3 --heldout). Same format as tests/dev/agents_cases.json. Facts: seeded ShopNova data (orders 4505-4515, products 1-6, clock 2026-10-09). Expectations were written from the seed data and the P20 rules by the Brain WITHOUT running anything; T30 checks them by reading only (never by running the agents).
written_by: Brain (Claude), 2026-11-02, draft for the team to review before the final check
